i100: yield weight with MLP(64,64) length model refit per epoch, chosen against kNN by held-out MSE each epoch. Pool benchmark MLP R2 0.757 vs kNN 0.681 at n=100; but a unit test found the MLP can invert ordering at small n, hence the per-epoch bake-off. Bounded below by yield_knn.

i100: yield weight with LEARNED length model (kNN regression on acquired start_state->true length) replacing the p_bar two-point mixture. 98.7% of Var(L) is the outcome label; kNN R2 0.687 at n=100 vs p_bar error ~0.8 at ep0. Targets the 6-8 epochs the weight is inert.
i100: E[L]-only control. Isolates the yield weight from the epistemic score; if it matches epi_var_yield the win is just 'buy long trajectories'.

Relaunch of the class-quota arm with the label-convention fix. 209584 imported the buggy class at parent startup (get_label returns {-1,+1} but the code tested ==0 for failure), so its gate can never turn on and it is a duplicate of epi_var; the strategy object is built once in the parent, NOT re-imported per epoch like mp.spawn trainer children. Fix normalises labels to {0,1} in _acquired_truth; regression test added.

Class-quota epi_var: kNN on ACQUIRED ground-truth labels splits candidates into predicted-fail/succ pots, quota_fail=pool tracks the measured class marginal, top-epi_var within each pot. p_bar appears nowhere in the composition path - that is the fix, since the p_bar->true-p gap on acquired batches plateaus at ~0.27-0.30 from ep8-19 and never closes. Ep0 gate: gate_on, realized pairs>=45k, fail fraction>=0.45. Falsifier: pairs<30k or fail-pot precision<0.75.
